Opportunities earlier available to
only the
ultra-rich,
now accessible to all

The opportunities to build generational wealth have always remained with those who
already have access to generational wealth. We are bridging this long existing accessibility gap
to such investment opportunities for retail investors.

Invest across multiple asset classes, returns, risk profiles, and tenure to
Build a portfolio that meets your investment needs and goals.

Build a portfolio that meets your investment needs and goals.

Across multiple asset classes, returns, risk profiles, and tenure

  • Corporate Debt (unlisted)

    • IRR10% - 16%
    • Tenure12-36 months

  • Invoice Discounting

    • IRR10% - 14%
    • Tenure1-6 months

  • Asset Leasing

    • IRR14% - 22%
    • Tenure24-48 months

  • Venture Debt

    • IRR15% - 18%
    • Tenure12-24 months

Higher returns

Predictable returns

One platform

Balanced portfolio

Higher returns than traditional fixed income assets

Kubera Scheme provides you the opportunity to diversify your investments from traditional fixed income asset classes to help you earn higher returns

Always know when your next payout is due; plan better

Predictable returns help you plan for your goals better. Kubera Scheme provides you with opportunities that range from 30 days to 3 years. You can choose the tenures and pay out structures that suit your goals.

A single platform to achieve all your financial goals

Invest across a range of fixed income asset classes that allow you to achieve all your financial goals on a single platform

Diversify your portfolio with non-market linked returns

If all growth capital is in equity linked investments, any volatility can cause our portfolio to suffer dramatically. Create a balanced portfolio by ensuring that part of your investments earn non-market linked returns.

We do the heavy-lifting for you
to
make investment easy

Get access to curated, risk-assessed
opportunities designed for retail investors.

Risk Assessed

The deals available on our platform undergo our rigorous and thorough internal credit and risk framework.

Diversified Investments

Choose to invest in opportunities across multiple asset classes.

Ease of Investing

Easy to understand platform with insights and knowledge to build your customised portfolio.

Secured deals

Access to opportunities that are backed by solid collateral or identified cashflows.

Start investing in just

3 minutes

opportunities designed for retail investors.
